connector.name: Basalt
connector.registryDescription: Design tokens, components, icons, and a11y data via MCP. For Cursor, Claude, and Windsurf.
connector.summary: Hosted at basalt.run over server sent events. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the basalt-run account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.description: Basalt API key from https://basalt.run Settings
